metadata.title: AI-Enabled Contracts Lab Contract Type and Clause Taxonomy
metadata.author: AI-Enabled Contracts Lab contributors
metadata.limitations: Definitions describe common drafting functions, not legal requirements or advice. Applicability and enforceability vary by jurisdiction, facts, parties, and document purpose.

domains.name: Commercial
domains.definition: Agreements governing goods, services, distribution, licensing, and ongoing business relationships.

domains.name: Corporate
domains.definition: Agreements concerning ownership, investment, governance, combinations, and business transfers.

domains.name: Employment
domains.definition: Agreements governing work relationships, compensation, duties, separation, and labor terms.

domains.name: Family
domains.definition: Agreements concerning family finances, property, support, and parenting, subject to jurisdiction-specific law and court review.

domains.name: Real Estate
domains.definition: Agreements concerning ownership, transfer, possession, construction, or use of real property.

domains.name: Finance
domains.definition: Agreements creating or supporting credit, repayment, collateral, guarantees, and financial covenants.

domains.name: Ip Technology
domains.definition: Agreements governing intellectual property, software, data, technology services, and related rights.

domains.name: Consumer
domains.definition: Agreements for products or services supplied to individuals, subject to mandatory consumer-protection law.

domains.name: Government
domains.definition: Agreements involving public procurement, grants, and flow-down requirements.

domains.name: Healthcare
domains.definition: Agreements concerning health services, protected data, research, providers, and regulated relationships.

contract_types.name: Non-disclosure agreement (NDA)
contract_types.definition: Protects confidential information disclosed for a defined purpose and may be mutual or unilateral.

contract_types.name: Master services agreement
contract_types.definition: Sets reusable legal and commercial terms for services ordered through statements of work.

contract_types.name: Statement of work
contract_types.definition: Defines project-specific scope, deliverables, schedule, responsibilities, and fees under a broader agreement.

contract_types.name: Software-as-a-service agreement
contract_types.definition: Governs hosted software access, service levels, data, security, support, and subscription payment.

contract_types.name: Supply agreement
contract_types.definition: Governs repeated supply of goods, forecasts, ordering, delivery, quality, and payment.

contract_types.name: Distribution agreement
contract_types.definition: Authorizes distribution or resale within defined products, channels, territory, and restrictions.

contract_types.name: Stock purchase agreement
contract_types.definition: Transfers shares or other equity interests from sellers to buyers.

contract_types.name: Asset purchase agreement
contract_types.definition: Transfers specified assets and assumed liabilities of a business.

contract_types.name: Merger agreement
contract_types.definition: Sets terms and conditions for combining entities through a statutory merger or similar transaction.

contract_types.name: Shareholders agreement
contract_types.definition: Governs ownership, voting, transfer restrictions, governance, and exit rights among shareholders.

contract_types.name: Joint venture agreement
contract_types.definition: Creates and governs a shared venture, including contributions, control, economics, and exit.

contract_types.name: Securities subscription agreement
contract_types.definition: Documents an investor's agreement to purchase securities subject to stated terms and representations.

contract_types.name: Employment agreement
contract_types.definition: Defines an employee's position, compensation, duties, benefits, restrictions, and termination terms.

contract_types.name: Offer letter
contract_types.definition: Summarizes proposed employment terms and conditions before or at hire.

contract_types.name: Independent contractor agreement
contract_types.definition: Governs services by a non-employee contractor and allocates status, payment, IP, confidentiality, and risk.

contract_types.name: Employment separation agreement
contract_types.definition: Documents employment separation, payments, releases, return of property, and continuing obligations.

contract_types.name: Restrictive covenant agreement
contract_types.definition: Contains non-competition, non-solicitation, confidentiality, or related post-relationship restrictions.

contract_types.name: Collective bargaining agreement
contract_types.definition: Sets collectively negotiated wages, hours, benefits, procedures, and other working conditions.

contract_types.name: Premarital agreement
contract_types.definition: Addresses property, debt, support, and related rights before marriage, subject to applicable law.

contract_types.name: Postmarital agreement
contract_types.definition: Addresses spouses' financial and property arrangements after marriage, subject to applicable law.

contract_types.name: Marital settlement agreement
contract_types.definition: Resolves property, debt, support, and related issues in connection with separation or dissolution.

contract_types.name: Family separation agreement
contract_types.definition: Sets agreed financial and personal arrangements while family-law parties live separately.

contract_types.name: Parenting plan
contract_types.definition: Documents custody, decision-making, parenting time, communication, and related child-focused arrangements.

contract_types.name: Commercial lease
contract_types.definition: Governs possession and use of commercial premises, rent, maintenance, risk, default, and remedies.

contract_types.name: Residential lease
contract_types.definition: Governs possession and use of residential premises subject to mandatory local law.

contract_types.name: Real estate purchase agreement
contract_types.definition: Sets terms for purchase and sale of real property.

contract_types.name: Construction agreement
contract_types.definition: Governs project scope, price, schedule, changes, payment, insurance, and completion.

contract_types.name: Easement agreement
contract_types.definition: Creates or documents rights to use another person's real property for a defined purpose.

contract_types.name: Loan agreement
contract_types.definition: Documents a lender's extension of credit and the borrower's repayment and covenant obligations.

contract_types.name: Credit agreement
contract_types.definition: Creates revolving, term, or other credit facilities with borrowing conditions and lender protections.

contract_types.name: Promissory note
contract_types.definition: Contains a written promise to pay a stated debt according to specified terms.

contract_types.name: Security agreement
contract_types.definition: Grants a security interest in collateral to secure an obligation.

contract_types.name: Guaranty
contract_types.definition: Creates a guarantor's obligation concerning another person's debt or performance.

contract_types.name: Software license agreement
contract_types.definition: Grants rights to use software subject to scope, restrictions, fees, support, warranties, and liability terms.

contract_types.name: Patent license
contract_types.definition: Grants defined rights under specified patents subject to field, territory, royalties, and other conditions.

contract_types.name: Trademark license
contract_types.definition: Permits use of specified marks subject to quality control, form, territory, and brand requirements.

contract_types.name: Data processing addendum
contract_types.definition: Defines privacy and security duties for processing personal information on another party's behalf.

contract_types.name: Terms of service
contract_types.definition: Sets rules for access to and use of a product, website, platform, or service.

contract_types.name: Consumer subscription agreement
contract_types.definition: Governs recurring consumer access, charges, renewal, cancellation, and service terms.

contract_types.name: Consumer warranty
contract_types.definition: States repair, replacement, refund, exclusions, duration, and claim procedures for a product or service.

contract_types.name: Government procurement contract
contract_types.definition: Governs acquisition of goods or services by a public entity under applicable procurement rules.

contract_types.name: Grant agreement
contract_types.definition: Provides funding for an approved public or charitable purpose subject to conditions, reporting, and oversight.

contract_types.name: Government subcontract
contract_types.definition: Passes defined performance and regulatory duties from a prime contract to a subcontractor.

contract_types.name: Business associate agreement
contract_types.definition: Allocates privacy and security duties involving protected health information between covered and service entities.

contract_types.name: Healthcare provider agreement
contract_types.definition: Governs participation, payment, service, records, compliance, and quality duties of a healthcare provider.

contract_types.name: Clinical trial agreement
contract_types.definition: Governs research conduct, funding, data, publication, safety, IP, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance.

contract_types.name: Data use agreement
contract_types.definition: Sets permitted uses, safeguards, disclosures, retention, and disposition for shared data.

clause_definitions.name: Parties
clause_definitions.definition: Identifies the people or entities entering the agreement and their defined roles.
review_questions: Are legal names and capacities correct?

clause_definitions.name: Definitions
clause_definitions.definition: Assigns specific meanings to capitalized or recurring terms used in the agreement.
review_questions: Are key terms complete and used consistently?

clause_definitions.name: Scope
clause_definitions.definition: Describes the goods, services, rights, relationship, or transaction covered by the agreement.
review_questions: Is the scope specific and measurable?

clause_definitions.name: Deliverables
clause_definitions.definition: Identifies required work products, outputs, milestones, or items to be delivered.
review_questions: Are owners, dates, and specifications clear?

clause_definitions.name: Acceptance
clause_definitions.definition: Defines how deliverables are tested, accepted, rejected, or deemed accepted.
review_questions: Are criteria objective and is the review period clear?

clause_definitions.name: Fees and payment
clause_definitions.definition: States prices, invoicing, payment timing, disputes, interest, and payment methods.
review_questions: What is due, when, and how are disputes handled?

clause_definitions.name: Term
clause_definitions.definition: States when the agreement begins and how long it remains in effect.
review_questions: Are the start and end rules unambiguous?

clause_definitions.name: Renewal
clause_definitions.definition: Describes extension or automatic renewal and notice needed to prevent it.
review_questions: What notice deadline prevents renewal?

clause_definitions.name: Termination
clause_definitions.definition: Defines rights to end the agreement for breach, convenience, insolvency, or other events and any cure period.
review_questions: Who may terminate, for what reason, and on what notice?

clause_definitions.name: Effects of termination
clause_definitions.definition: Specifies payment, transition, return, survival, and other consequences after termination.
review_questions: Which duties and rights continue?

clause_definitions.name: Confidentiality obligation
clause_definitions.definition: Restricts unauthorized use or disclosure of protected information.
review_questions: Who is bound, for what information, and for how long?

clause_definitions.name: Definition of confidential information
clause_definitions.definition: Defines information treated as confidential, including form and marking requirements.
review_questions: Does it cover oral, electronic, and derived information?

clause_definitions.name: Confidentiality exclusions
clause_definitions.definition: Excludes information that is public, previously known, independently developed, or lawfully received.
review_questions: Are standard exclusions present and who bears proof?

clause_definitions.name: Permitted use restriction
clause_definitions.definition: Limits protected information or assets to a defined purpose.
review_questions: Is the allowed purpose specific?

clause_definitions.name: Representatives and need-to-know access
clause_definitions.definition: Allows limited access by personnel or advisers who need the information and are bound to protect it.
review_questions: Who is responsible for representative conduct?

clause_definitions.name: Compelled disclosure
clause_definitions.definition: Addresses disclosure required by law, subpoena, court order, or government demand.
review_questions: Is advance notice required when legally permitted?

clause_definitions.name: Standard of care
clause_definitions.definition: Sets the degree of care or safeguards required to protect information or property.
review_questions: Is the standard objective and measurable?

clause_definitions.name: Return or destruction
clause_definitions.definition: Requires return, deletion, or destruction of information or property at a specified time.
review_questions: Are backups, retention law, and certification addressed?

clause_definitions.name: Survival
clause_definitions.definition: Identifies provisions that continue after expiration or termination.
review_questions: Which duties survive and for how long?

clause_definitions.name: Intellectual property ownership
clause_definitions.definition: Allocates ownership of background materials, work product, inventions, data, or other intellectual property.
review_questions: What is pre-existing and what is newly created?

clause_definitions.name: License grant
clause_definitions.definition: Gives defined permission to use specified intellectual property subject to scope and restrictions.
review_questions: Is it exclusive, transferable, sublicensable, territorial, and time-limited?

clause_definitions.name: Data rights
clause_definitions.definition: Allocates rights in supplied, generated, derived, or aggregated data.
review_questions: Who controls inputs, outputs, and derived data?

clause_definitions.name: Privacy and information security
clause_definitions.definition: Addresses personal-information processing and administrative, technical, or physical safeguards.
review_questions: Which laws, roles, data, safeguards, and incident duties apply?

clause_definitions.name: Representations and warranties
clause_definitions.definition: States factual assurances or promises about authority, condition, quality, performance, or compliance.
review_questions: What is promised, qualified, and remedied?

clause_definitions.name: Warranty disclaimer
clause_definitions.definition: Limits or excludes warranties, often including implied warranties.
review_questions: Which warranties are excluded and is the disclaimer conspicuous?

clause_definitions.name: Indemnification
clause_definitions.definition: Allocates responsibility for specified third-party claims, losses, defense, or reimbursement.
review_questions: What claims are covered and who controls the defense?

clause_definitions.name: Limitation of liability
clause_definitions.definition: Caps liability or excludes categories of damages subject to stated carve-outs.
review_questions: What is the cap and which claims are carved out?

clause_definitions.name: Compliance with law
clause_definitions.definition: Requires performance consistent with identified laws, regulations, policies, or permits.
review_questions: Are named regimes and responsibility allocations current?

clause_definitions.name: Audit and records
clause_definitions.definition: Permits review of records, controls, facilities, or compliance and sets retention duties.
review_questions: What is the scope, frequency, notice, cost, and retention period?

clause_definitions.name: Assignment
clause_definitions.definition: Controls transfer of contractual rights, duties, or the agreement itself.
review_questions: Is consent required and are transactions or affiliates excepted?

clause_definitions.name: Force majeure
clause_definitions.definition: Excuses or delays performance for defined events beyond a party's reasonable control.
review_questions: Which events qualify and what notice or mitigation is required?

clause_definitions.name: Dispute resolution
clause_definitions.definition: Sets escalation, mediation, arbitration, litigation, or other dispute procedures.
review_questions: Is the process mandatory, exclusive, and workable?

clause_definitions.name: Governing law and forum
clause_definitions.definition: Names the law and location intended to govern interpretation and disputes.
review_questions: Are the selected law and forum approved and practical?

clause_definitions.name: Restrictive covenants
clause_definitions.definition: Restricts competition, solicitation, hiring, or other post-relationship conduct for a defined scope and period.
review_questions: Is the restriction permitted and appropriately scoped in the relevant jurisdiction?

clause_definitions.name: Employment duties and compensation
clause_definitions.definition: Defines position, responsibilities, reporting, salary, bonus, equity, and benefits.
review_questions: What is fixed, discretionary, conditional, or recoverable?

clause_definitions.name: Invention assignment
clause_definitions.definition: Allocates rights in inventions or works created during a work relationship.
review_questions: What creations and time periods are covered?

clause_definitions.name: Severance
clause_definitions.definition: Provides pay or benefits associated with specified termination circumstances.
review_questions: What conditions, releases, and offsets apply?

clause_definitions.name: Transaction price, representations, conditions, and closing
clause_definitions.definition: Sets consideration, factual assurances, pre-closing conditions, covenants, and completion mechanics for an acquisition or transfer.
review_questions: How are price, risk, conditions, deliverables, and survival allocated?

clause_definitions.name: Credit, collateral, default, and guaranty
clause_definitions.definition: Defines repayment, covenants, collateral rights, default events, and any secondary payment obligation.
review_questions: Are payment, collateral, cure, enforcement, and guarantor scope clear?

clause_definitions.name: Property and debt division
clause_definitions.definition: Allocates identified assets, liabilities, valuation dates, and transfer responsibilities between family-law parties.
review_questions: Are assets, debts, values, and transfer steps identified?

clause_definitions.name: Support
clause_definitions.definition: Addresses spousal, child, or other support payment obligations and modification rules.
review_questions: Are amount, duration, tax treatment, and modification standards clear?

clause_definitions.name: Parenting arrangements
clause_definitions.definition: Addresses custody, decision-making, parenting time, communication, and related child-focused arrangements.
review_questions: Does the arrangement meet governing law and required child-focused review?

clause_definitions.name: Covenants
clause_definitions.definition: Requires or prohibits conduct before, during, or after a transaction or relationship.
review_questions: Are duties measurable and exceptions clear?

clause_definitions.name: Conditions precedent
clause_definitions.definition: Lists conditions that must be satisfied or waived before a duty, funding, or closing occurs.
review_questions: Who controls satisfaction and waiver?

clause_definitions.name: Insurance
clause_definitions.definition: Requires specified coverage, limits, endorsements, certificates, or notice of cancellation.
review_questions: Are coverage types and limits appropriate to the work?
